author: ETA PRIME
description:
This is the most powerful all-AMD dual-boot gaming PC I’ve built on the channel—set up with Windows 11 Pro + Official SteamOS so you can pick the best OS for each game. I built this as a gift for my best friend, and in this video we’re focusing on SteamOS performance at 4K and comparing it to Windows 11 in the same games at the same settings.
Dual-boot is the move here—some games run better on SteamOS, some run better on Windows 11, and this setup gives you both.
